verdict.rationale: Baseten supports bulk inference workloads. Async inference is documented as suited to batch work, with completion via webhook or polling, and the Performance Client sends concurrent requests from Python, JavaScript, or Rust. A community developer also describes building a Rust client to push high-throughput embedding workloads. However, nothing documents a dedicated batch API or bulk management actions across many workspace resources, so the story is only partly met through concurrency and async workarounds. Missing for 10: a native batch-job API (submit one file or job covering many items), bulk management operations across deployments or resources, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale batch runs.
